name: Supporter Recognition - The Wall As It Stands
description: The section that closes the gap this whole page was built to close: the donor wall that is already shipped, which the review previously never pointed at. Nine alternative directions cannot be judged against nothing, so W1-W5 name what the wall does today — giving levels as the structure, the Founding Donor badge cutting across them, the anonymity contract, the filter chips, the designed empty state — beside a capture of the real component rather than a redrawing of it. The capture is inlined by build.py from the committed donor-wall scenarios, so a wall that changes cannot leave this section describing a page that no longer exists.
